modalLead: The action bar's buttons can swell into view, and a round of fixes makes moving blocks, Structure and the Inbox safer.

items.text: The buttons can swell into view one after the other each time the bar appears. Switch it on under Config → Appearance → Action bar; it is off by default.
Moving a block to another page no longer shows the old page's widgets when you switch pages while it moves, and a double press moves it only once.
Typing in the search box lets go of a picked-up block, so your arrow keys and Enter go to the search again.
Undo after a move says so when the page was reloaded meanwhile, instead of undoing what another device changed.
Merging or deleting a category in Structure works on the right category, even when the list refreshes while you confirm.
A bulk move to another page takes away exactly the bookmarks you moved.
Show in list (was Show in Health) opens a fully styled Bookmarks view, and the bookmark menu no longer cuts off its key hints.
A page that briefly cannot be read no longer shows up empty, and icons are no longer thrown away at that moment.
The inbox is always on. Its switch under Config → Inbox is gone, so an install that had turned it off has the inbox back. In Config, Structure and Behavior now sit above Inbox.
Keep on several links runs once on a double click, and promote tells you which links could not leave the Inbox.
The section menu filters only the newest release, not the older ones you opened below it.
The public demo is more careful with visitors' changes and resets cleanly, even when someone saves at that very moment.
